titles.title: ถอดรหัสนิมิต ชะตาซ่อนกล

description:
Just as gates opened and monsters poured out, plunging the world into despair, a very small fraction of humanity awakened as “Espers” with special abilities, while another group awakened as “Guides” who can control them.

Before anyone could even feel relieved by their appearance, a terrorist guild known as “Ryeowon” emerges. To wipe them out in a special operation, S-class Guide Sunwoo Jeong and A-class precognitive Esper Joo Won-gyeom are brought together for the first time.

“Looks like we’re highly compatible, Sunwoo Jeong.”

Contrary to the rumors of his incredible ability to foresee the future, Won-gyeom lacks any ounce of seriousness, throwing out highly suggestive jokes right from their first meeting. This leaves Jeong deeply disappointed...

“Are you covering my face because you're afraid you'll fall for my handsome looks?”  
“So, being forceful is your preference~?”  
“Just slip it in a little. I’ll tighten up nicely for you.”

However... as they spend more time together, Jeong realizes that Won-gyeom is harboring his own unspoken pain. Before he knows it, Jeong finds himself entirely unable to take his eyes off of him.
